title: Operations Specialist III, Aerospace & Defense (US)
description:
Company Introduction:

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.  

Airspace has been rated one of  America’s best Startup Employers and listed as one of  CNBC’s Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m. 

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics. 

 

Be the Team's Deepest Problem-Solver

Every ops floor needs a small number of people who can be handed the hardest problem in the queue and trusted to get it right - balancing cost, speed, and customer impact without defaulting to escalation. As an Operations Specialist III, you're that person for your team.

You resolve what OS I and OS II can't, you help the team solve it themselves next time, and you understand the business well enough to make the close calls - which carrier, which cost, which tradeoff - that protect both service quality and margin. For the rare issue that needs to be fielded by someone supporting Ops leadership and account managers directly, you know when to bring in an Ops Expert.

 

What You'll Do

Must be able to perform all responsibilities included in the Operations Specialist II job description, in addition to the following:

Resolve the Hardest Escalations

• Independently resolve all escalated issues using available resources with minimal to no assistance

• Assist in resolving team member escalations and questions

• Anticipate problems before they surface and act early

Make the Margin and Cost Tradeoffs

• Understand margin versus total cost for an order and apply that knowledge to additional charge approvals

• Balance speed, cost, and customer impact when making big-picture decisions, without defaulting to escalation (e.g., choosing a carrier based on service reliability and error-rate history rather than the fastest or cheapest option alone)

• Maintain deep, practiced knowledge of the trade, regulatory, and compliance requirements relevant to your assigned sector

Set the Standard for the Team

• Serve as the go-to resource on sector-specific process nuance and edge cases within the team

• Flag SOP gaps and suggest improvements to your supervisor based on frontline experience

• Uphold team expectations by leading through example

• Maintain any certifications required for your assigned sector and stay current on related compliance requirements; assist teammates with related questions

Maintain a Balanced Level of Performance

As an OS III, you'll be expected to maintain minimal to no errors or service failures, make sound decisions under pressure, and meet the customer service standards appropriate for this level. Specific metrics vary by sector and will be communicated by your direct reporting supervisor.

 

Requirements

• Demonstrated success as an Operations Specialist II, or equivalent experience independently resolving complex, time-critical logistics escalations

title: 2027 Summer Intern, PhD, Machine Learning, Planning/Prediction
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Software Engineering builds the brains of Waymo's fully autonomous driving technology. Our software allows the Waymo Driver to perceive the world around it, make the right decision for every situation, and deliver people safely to their destinations. We think deeply and solve complex technical challenges in areas like robotics, perception, decision-making and deep learning, while collaborating with hardware and systems engineers. These models enable the autonomous vehicle to navigate complex environments safely and efficiently.

Waymo interns partner with leaders in the industry on projects that create impact to the company. title: Senior DevSecOps & Platform Engineering Lead
description:
Senior DevSecOps & Platform Engineering Lead
Full-Time W-2 | Fully Remote (U.S.) | Federal Civilian Practice
The Problem We're Hiring You to Solve
A 20-year-old federal platform sits behind a home loan benefit that millions of American families depend on. Your job is to help retire it without anyone noticing.
You will own the DevSecOps and platform engineering ecosystem for a modernization program that runs legacy and modern stacks side by side: pipelines that move code from commit to production in under an hour, zero-downtime production deployments, environments built and torn down as code, and observability deep enough to explain a failure before the customer reports it. You will do this inside real federal security constraints, with real authority over how the engineering system works, and with AI as a first-class engineering tool.
The Opportunity
Most DevSecOps roles hand you an inherited pipeline and a backlog of tickets. This one hands you an engineering system to shape.
The program spans multiple applications, technology stacks, and platforms: a legacy suite that must stay stable and secure until it is decommissioned, and a modern cloud platform (Salesforce-centered, supplemented by serverless capabilities in a government cloud) where new capability lands every month. Production runs 24/7 against contractual availability targets. Releases ship to production at least monthly. Critical vulnerabilities must close in 30 days. The monitoring bar is full business transaction visibility, not “the server is up.”
You will lead the engineers who make all of that true. Not from a status meeting. From the architecture, the pipeline definitions, the incident bridge, and the customer conversation. You will decide how code moves from a developer's hands to production, how failures get detected and diagnosed, how security gets enforced without slowing delivery, and where automation and AI replace manual work.
The outcomes are measured, visible, and attached to a mission that matters. When deployments get faster and incidents get rarer, the customer sees it, and so do the people the program serves.
A note on the stack. If “Salesforce” made you hesitate, read this twice. You will not become a Salesforce administrator, and this role will not narrow your career. The application platform is Salesforce. The engineering system around it is not. The CI/CD architecture, environment automation, serverless cloud components, observability, security automation, legacy systems, and AI-enabled workflows are general-purpose platform engineering, and that is where you will spend your time. A strong platform engineer picks up the Salesforce-specific pieces quickly. The reverse is not true, which is why we are hiring for the former.
What You'll Own

• The delivery platform. Design and run CI/CD that lets teams move code from commit to production across multiple applications, stacks, and environments with minimal manual intervention. The standard: builds, tests, and deployments complete in under an hour, and production releases ship monthly or faster.

• Zero-downtime release engineering. Build deployment automation that verifies a release in production before users touch it, and rolls back cleanly when verification fails. Boring deployments are the goal.

• Environments as code. Automate provisioning so a complete environment stands up or tears down in days, not months, and configuration drift stops being a source of incidents.

• Security engineered into the pipeline. Make quality and security gates automatic, surface vulnerabilities early instead of at audit time, and drive remediation inside federal 30/60/90-day windows for critical, high, and medium findings. Support multi-year authorizations to operate and the program's Zero Trust alignment as engineering work, not paperwork theater.

• Working knowledge of loan servicing, deferment, forbearance, and default

• US-based

Certificates and/or Licenses:

Licensure and prescriptive authority must be obtained and maintained for all required jurisdictions. Applications for required licenses must be submitted within 60 days of the date of hire and/or receiving notification. Kodland ’e katılın - 5-17 yaş arası çocuklara online kodlama, matematik ve dijital beceri eğitimleri sunan global bir eğitim platformuyuz. 40 ülkede 30.000’den fazla öğrenciyle çalışıyor, çocukların geleceğin becerilerini erken yaşta kazanmasına destek oluyoruz.
STEM akreditasyonuna sahip eğitim yaklaşımımızla, öğrencilerin yalnızca teknik bilgi edinmesini değil; problem çözme, mantıksal düşünme, yaratıcılık, proje üretme ve özgüven kazanmasını hedefliyoruz.
Roblox Eğitmeni olarak göreviniz, Kodland tarafından sağlanan hazır ders materyalleriyle öğrencilerimize online grup dersleri vermek, Roblox Studio üzerinden oyun geliştirme mantığını çocuklara anlaşılır ve eğlenceli şekilde aktarmak ve öğrencilerin kendi projelerini geliştirmelerine rehberlik etmek olacaktır.
Bu rolde sizden beklenenler:

•
Kodland ’ın sağladığı müfredat ve materyallerle online Roblox dersleri yürütmek

• Öğrencilere Roblox Studio kullanımı, oyun mantığı, temel script yapıları ve proje geliştirme süreçlerinde rehberlik etmek

• Öğrencilerin yaşına ve seviyesine uygun, sade ve anlaşılır açıklamalar yapmak

• Grup derslerinde öğrencilerin aktif katılımını ve yaratıcılığını desteklemek

• Öğrencilerin sınıf içi çalışmalarını, ödevlerini ve proje ilerlemelerini düzenli olarak takip etmek

• Derslerden sonra sınıf raporlarını doldurmak

• Takım lideri ve operasyon ekibiyle düzenli iletişimde kalmak

• Kalite ekibinden gelen geri bildirimlere açık olmak ve öğretim becerilerinizi geliştirmek

Dersler uzaktan yürütülür. Ders içerikleri, metodolojik materyaller ve onboarding sürecindeki yönlendirmeler Kodland tarafından sağlanır.
Requirements
Aradığımız profil:

• Roblox Studio kullanımı konusunda bilgi ve pratik deneyime sahip olmak

• Temel oyun geliştirme mantığını bilmek

• Lua / Luau veya benzer script mantığına aşina olmak

• Çocuklarla iletişim kurmayı sevmek ve sabırlı bir öğretim yaklaşımına sahip olmak

• Teknik konuları çocukların seviyesine inerek sade şekilde açıklayabilmek

• Öğrencilerin yaptığı hataları fark edip onları doğru şekilde yönlendirebilmek

• Online ders yürütmeye uygun bilgisayar, kamera, mikrofon ve stabil internet bağlantısına sahip olmak

• Zoom kullanmaya ve online eğitim araçlarını öğrenmeye açık olmak

• Haftada en az 10 saat uygunluk sağlayabilmek

• Hafta içi 16:00-22:30 ve hafta sonu 08:00-22:30 saat aralıklarında ders verebilecek uygunluğa sahip olmak

• Düzenli, sorumluluk sahibi ve iletişimi güçlü olmak

Tercihen:

• Daha önce çocuklara veya gençlere eğitim verme deneyimi olması

• Roblox Studio’da kendi oyun/proje geliştirme deneyimi bulunması

• Oyun mekanikleri, karakter hareketleri, leaderboard, basit UI veya event sistemi gibi konulara aşina olmak

• Scratch, Python veya başka bir görsel/programlama aracına aşina olmak

• Öğrenci merkezli öğretim, keşfederek öğrenme ve proje tabanlı ders anlatımı konusunda istekli olmak

• Geri bildirim almaya ve öğretim becerilerini geliştirmeye açık olmak

Size sunduklarımız:

• Hazır ve yapılandırılmış ders materyalleri

• Kapsamlı işe alım desteği ve eğitmen eğitimi

• Roblox derslerine hazırlık sürecinde metodolojik destek

• Takım lideri desteği
• Kalite ekibinden düzenli geri bildirim
• Esnek çalışma saatleri
• Uzaktan çalışma imkânı

• Performans ve ders kalitesine bağlı kazanç artışı

•
Kodland ’ın global eğitim topluluğunun bir parçası olma fırsatı

title: Reliability Engineer
description:
Reliability Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Reliability Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $75,000-$95,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Reliability Engineer to ensure the availability, performance, and operational excellence of large-scale distributed systems in production. As an SRE you will live at the boundary between development and operations, applying strong software engineering principles to infrastructure and operations problems, and continually pushing the platform toward higher reliability with lower operational toil. The ideal candidate will combine deep systems knowledge with strong programming skills, a measurement-driven mindset, and the discipline to design, automate, and operate complex services so that reliability becomes a first-class engineering deliverable rather than a reactive concern.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Five or more years of SRE, DevOps, or production engineering experience supporting large-scale distributed systems.

• Strong programming skills in at least one of Python, Go, or Java, with the ability to build robust automation and tooling.

• Deep, hands-on experience operating Linux at scale, including networking, performance tuning, and systems-level troubleshooting.

• Production experience operating Kubernetes and container-based workloads.

• Strong working knowledge of observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK/EFK, or commercial equivalents.

• Hands-on experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines for both infrastructure and applications.

• Solid understanding of distributed system design, including consistency models, partitioning, and failure semantics.

• Demonstrated experience leading incident response and conducting effective post-incident reviews.

• Excellent communication and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience defining and operationalizing SLOs and error budgets in real production environments.

• Exposure to chaos engineering practices and tools such as Chaos Monkey, Gremlin, or Litmus.

• Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

• Background in capacity planning, performance engineering, or large-scale load testing.

• Familiarity with service mesh technologies such as Istio, Linkerd, or Consul.

title: Patient Care Coordinator - B075 (SR)
description:
Work From Anywhere in LATAM or the Philippines
Work Schedule: CST │ 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM (Monday-Friday)
About Pearl Talent

Pearl works with the top 1% of candidates from around the world and connects them with the best startups in the US and EU. Our clients have raised over $5B in aggregate and are backed by companies like OpenAI, a16z, and Founders Fund.
Hear why we exist, what we believe in, and who we're building for:
Watch here:
About the Client
An early-stage AI healthtech company is building a clinical co-pilot platform for urgent care practices across the US, and is hiring a Patient Referral Coordinator to take on the human side of its patient referral outreach.
The company's platform flags care gaps in real time and is scaling quickly across its network of urgent care clinics - this is the company's first hire dedicated to this function, with referral outreach currently handled directly by the founding team.
About the Role
As Patient Referral Coordinator, you'll call patients flagged by the platform for specialist follow-up, explain in plain language why the referral matters, address questions or hesitations, and help them book their next appointment - either directly or via follow-up text, email, or voicemail. The role starts light and is expected to scale over the coming months as referral volume grows; success is measured by booking conversion rate and how quickly you respond to new referral notifications.
Core Responsibilities
Patient Outreach & Booking

• Call referral-eligible patients flagged by the platform, starting at approximately 5 patients per day and scaling over time

• Explain in plain language why a specialist referral is needed based on the patient's care gap

• Address patient objections and questions with empathy, guiding them toward booking without pressure

• Book appointments directly through the internal dashboard or coordinate with the patient's preferred provider

• Maintain a booking conversion rate of 80%+ across all eligible patients contacted

Follow-Up & Patient Communication

• Leave voicemails and send text/email follow-ups for patients who don't answer on the first attempt

• Re-contact patients from previous days who have not yet booked

• Research and answer patient questions about insurance, logistics, or referral reasoning

• Escalate clinical questions outside scope to the appropriate internal contact

Dashboard & Compliance

• Review overnight patient notifications each morning via the internal dashboard

• Update patient status (booked, no answer, declined, follow-up needed) using the platform's workflow tools

• Access and review medical record summaries to understand patient context before calling

• Handle Protected Health Information (PHI) in accordance with HIPAA and company data protocols

• Maintain accurate documentation of all patient interactions

Requirements
Requirements
Must-Have

• 2+ years of experience in patient-facing healthcare coordination, medical customer service, or healthcare BPO roles involving outbound phone communication

• Demonstrated experience with objection-handling or conversion-focused communication (e.g., appointment-setting, booking rate metrics, or persuasion-based customer service)

• Experience working directly with US-based patients, clients, or customers by phone

• C2 CEFR English fluency (near-native, unobstructive accent for US patient-facing calls)

• Experience navigating CRM, scheduling, or patient management dashboards

• Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision (e.g., small-team, startup, or remote BPO environment)

• Availability to work 9:00 AM-5:00 PM Central Time

Nice-to-Have

• Spanish-English bilingual fluency (B2+ CEFR Spanish)

• Familiarity with medical terminology, ICD diagnosis codes, or insurance verification processes

• Prior HIPAA or PHI handling training

• Experience in an early-stage startup or fast-scaling, low-structure environment

Benefits

•
Competitive Salary: Based on experience

title: Recruiting Coordinator (Contract)
description:
We're hiring for a Recruiting Coordinator to help us keep hiring at Coder organized and welcoming. You'll keep scheduling running smoothly, generally support our Recruiting Team, and make sure candidates have a great experience throughout the interview process. You'll also help identify improvements that make hiring a better experience for everyone.

This position is slated as contract-to-hire, and we’re looking for someone who is able to join us in our Austin office occasionally.

WHAT YOU’LL DO HERE

- Coordinate virtual and in-person interviews across teams and time zones, ensuring a smooth experience for everyone involved

- Thoroughly document interview processes, interviewer roles, and other relevant details to help better prepare candidates and interviewers

- Proactively identify opportunities to streamline coordination and improve the candidate and hiring team experience

- Generally support day-to-day recruiting operations

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- 1+ year(s) of experience in recruiting coordination, talent acquisition, HR, administrative support, or another similar role

- Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to juggle competing priorities

- Clear and friendly communication, both written and verbal

- A candidate-first mindset and genuine interest in creating a positive experience for everyone involved in hiring

- Experience using AI, an Applicant Tracking System (Ashby, Greenhouse, etc.), and standard web-based tools (Google Workspace or similar)

BONUS TACOS IF YOU HAVE

- (Tacos? If you need an ice-breaker, ask how we say thanks by giving tacos!)

- Experience using Ashby ATS

- Prior experience at a quickly scaling technical startup

- Interest in growing professionally into a full-cycle Recruiter

ABOUT CODER

Coder is the leading platform for AI development Infrastructure, enabling enterprises to securely run human and AI-driven development workflows in consistent, governed environments. Coder provides self-hosted, agent-ready workspaces that unify developer productivity and platform governance. With Coder, enterprises can confidently evolve from human-only development to AI-assisted and autonomous workflows, without sacrificing security, compliance, or performance. Learn more at coder.com http://coder.com.

INTERVIEW PROCESS 

We believe that the interview process should be transparent, consistent, and enjoyable. We value your time and hope to complete the interview process in two to four weeks, if schedules allow. Through your interviews, you will meet a mix of individual contributors, managers, and senior leaders.

AI USE DURING THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

As an AI company, Coder embraces the use of AI tools, and we want to be transparent about our expectations as you navigate our interview process.

Not permitted: Using AI assistance during conversational interviews.

Permitted: Using AI tooling for take-home assessments. Please flag where and to what extent it was used in your take-home. Your submission will not be penalized for using AI as long as it is done honestly.

OUR USE OF AI IN HIRING

We use AI tools to help manage our recruitment process efficiently and fairly. Specifically:

- Ashby helps us review inbound applications by surfacing candidates who best match the role requirements we've defined. This tool does not make hiring decisions; it helps our team prioritize which applications to review first.

- Granola takes notes during our interview calls so our team can focus on the conversation with you.

All hiring decisions are made by humans. Our team reviews applications, conducts interviews, and makes final selections. AI tools assist us but never replace human judgment, and these practices are conducted in compliance with applicable data protection, AI governance, and labor laws. Your data is not used to train AI models.

description:
تسجيل فيديو باللغة العربية - عُمان
يمكن لمهاراتك في اللغة العربية أن تساهم في تحسين تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي.
المهام

• تسجيل مقطع فيديو واحد مدته من 15 إلى 20 ثانية باستخدام لهجتك العربية الأصلية.

• التحدث بشكل طبيعي ومن دون نص مكتوب مسبقًا. يمكنك، على سبيل المثال، التعريف بنفسك باختصار، أو ذكر مكان إقامتك، أو التحدث عن أحد اهتماماتك أو هواياتك.

• النظر مباشرة إلى الكاميرا طوال مدة التسجيل.

• بعد التسجيل، الإجابة عن بعض الأسئلة القصيرة عن نفسك، مثل الفئة العمرية، والدولة، واللهجة، لمساعدتنا في تنظيم مجموعة البيانات.

متطلبات التسجيل
يجب استيفاء جميع المتطلبات التالية حتى يتم قبول الفيديو:

•
جودة الفيديو: 1080p أو أعلى.

•
المدة: من 15 إلى 20 ثانية.

•
التصوير: يجب أن يظهر الرأس والكتفان، وأن يكون الوجه في منتصف الصورة وواضحًا بالكامل.

•
الإضاءة والخلفية: يجب أن يكون الوجه مضاءً جيدًا ومن دون ظلال قوية، مع خلفية بسيطة أو محايدة.

•
تعبيرات الوجه: طبيعية وهادئة أثناء التحدث.

•
الصوت: واضح ومن دون ضوضاء في الخلفية أو موسيقى أو صدى.

•
اتجاه التصوير: يمكن التصوير بشكل رأسي أو أفقي، مع تثبيت الكاميرا وتجنب الاهتزاز.

•
مكان التسجيل: يُفضل التسجيل في مكان داخلي هادئ.

•
غير مسموح: استخدام الفلاتر أو أوضاع التجميل، النظارات الشمسية، القبعات أو أغطية الرأس التي تحجب الوجه، أغطية الوجه، سماعات الرأس أو سماعات الأذن، العلامات المائية، الملصقات، الإطارات، أو ظهور أشخاص آخرين أو حيوانات أليفة في الفيديو.

متطلبات المشاركة

• أن يكون عمرك 18 عامًا أو أكثر.

• أن تكون متحدثًا أصليًا باللغة العربية وفقًا لتحديدك الذاتي. وقد يُطلب منك إكمال خطوة تحقق قصيرة لتأكيد لهجتك قبل اعتماد مشاركتك بشكل نهائي.

We are seeking a highly skilled, experienced, and proactive  Expert General Ledger Accountant to join our Central Accounting Team.

This position plays a key role in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and timely execution of General Ledger accounting activities, while contributing to risk management, process efficiency, and continuous improvement.

Beyond executing accounting activities, the successful candidate will be expected to work independently, anticipate challenges, identify improvement opportunities, and actively contribute to initiatives that strengthen financial operations.

The role requires close collaboration with regional and headquarters Finance teams, Tax, Legal, Systems, and other internal stakeholders.

About the Role

 

• Accounting, Budgeting & Tax Compliance: Lead best-in-class financial processes for the Hub entity, including budget/forecast monitoring, variance reporting, annual budgeting exercises, and coordination with external tax consultants for timely tax declarations, audits, and full regulatory compliance.

• General Ledger & Financial Control: Oversee GL accounting activities across all entities, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to corporate policies, accounting standards, and internal controls throughout monthly, quarterly, and annual closing cycles.

• Audit & Internal Controls Support: Support internal and external audits by providing accurate documentation, timely explanations, and ensuring compliance with established accounting procedures and control frameworks.

• Quality Service & Stakeholder Management: Deliver accurate, timely accounting services; proactively identify errors and process inefficiencies; implement corrective actions; maintain process documentation; and foster a service-oriented mindset with all internal stakeholders.

• Cross-Functional Vision & Process Integration: Recognize and leverage the interconnection between GL and other functions (AP, AR, Tax, Treasury, FP&A) to drive process improvements and strengthen financial controls beyond transactional scope.

• Ownership, Continuous Improvement & Results Delivery: Demonstrate full accountability for deliverables, work independently under tight deadlines, anticipate operational challenges, and actively contribute to accounting transformation projects, system implementations, and process improvement initiatives in a fast-paced international environment.

About You

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA or equivalent certification preferred.

• Solid knowledge of IFRS and financial reporting requirements.

• Proven experience in financial closing, account reconciliations, journal entries, accruals, and accounting analysis.

• Experience working with ERP systems, preferably Oracle Fusion.

title: Meridial – Scientist – In Vivo Neuroscience
description:
About Meridial
 
Meridial is a Focused Research Organisation (FRO) with a mission to bring connectomics into the living brain. We are building a platform for longitudinal, synapse-resolution mapping of functional neural circuitry in preclinical models. Our aim is to deploy this platform for translational projects and improve drug development outcomes for disorders of the central nervous system. 
 
Meridial is a new not-for-profit FRO in the Convergent Research Ecosystem and funded by the Advanced Research and Invention Agency (ARIA).
 
About the role
 
Meridial is seeking a Scientist - In Vivo Neuroscience to play a central role in establishing and running our in vivo experiments.
 
This is a hands-on scientific role focused on the development and execution of advanced in vivo neuroscience experiments. You will perform complex neurosurgery, longitudinal two-photon imaging and optogenetic experiments in mice, and develop new approaches as part of Meridial’s programme to create advanced 3D imaging and photostimulation technologies for functional mapping of neural circuits. We are looking for an exceptional experimentalist who combines substantial practical expertise with scientific independence. We would also welcome candidates who combine these experimental skills with substantial expertise in neural data analysis.
 
You will report to the Director of Experimental Research and work closely with them to build the lab. You will play a central role in establishing our core surgical, imaging and optogenetic protocols and the quality standards that underpin them. As the team grows over the coming year, you will train and mentor other scientists, guide their day-to-day experimental work and help shape how the team works together. You will also work closely with engineers and computational researchers across Meridial.

Acting as a bridge between our world-class AI/Engineering teams and our commercial and scientific partners in Singapore, you will play a critical part in accelerating CuspAI’s growth and mission-driven impact in the APAC region by ensuring technical deliverables are aligned with real-world needs.

Your main focus initially will be to grow and manage a high-performing technical team and establish yourself as the primary technical contact for all regional projects. - Act as the main technical point of contact for all CuspAI projects and partnerships in Singapore.

- Develop and articulate the technical capabilities of the CuspAI platform to partners and potential clients.

- Play hands-on roles in all aspects of technical projects, including writing detailed technical proposals, defining project objectives, and delivering projects.

- Translate high-level commercial requirements from the Chief Strategy Officer, Managing Director, Singapore and partners into achievable, well-defined technical work packages and realistic deliverables.

- Work closely with Technical Program Managers (TPMs), Application Scientists, and the core ML and Platform Engineering teams to map out project timelines and resource allocation.

Team Management & Development

Staff: Lead a domain such as execution, tenant security, data infrastructure or reliability across teams.

Python FastAPI, AWS Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway and containers. Data and security use RDS PostgreSQL, pgvector, S3 Object Lock, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch and CloudTrail. The frontend uses React and AWS Amplify.

- Care deeply about reliability, observability, developer experience, and reducing time from code change to trustworthy signal.

title: Senior Engineering Manager, AI-Native R&D
description:
About Nerdio

At Nerdio , our mission is to simplify the lives of IT professionals and maximize their Microsoft cloud and end user computing investments.

We support organizations of all sizes looking to deploy, manage, and cost-optimize native Microsoft technologies. We partner with Enterprises and Managed Service Providers all over the world to add value on top of their existing native Microsoft investments like Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365, and Microsoft Intune.

Created in 2016, Nerdio has always taken a market-leading and collaborative approach to cloud deployment and management. In fact, our product roadmap is greatly influenced by the regular feedback we receive from having seen companies deploy AVD into production environments several thousand times using Nerdio technology.

Today, Nerdio is used in over 50 countries by more than 15,000 organizations of every size and vertical. We’re committed to delivering exceptional service and support, which starts with identifying and supporting the best staff possible.

We are a fast-moving, nimble company looking for individuals who are collaborative, empathetic, driven and who love to move at the speed of light. If you want to be part of the AVD transformation that Microsoft and Nerdio are leading, then we want to speak with you.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a growing AI-native R&D team of 10+ engineers. This dual-track role combines direct people management with hands-on coding, architecture, and technical execution. You will remain close to the work, establish responsible AI-assisted development practices, and earn technical trust by helping solve the group’s most difficult engineering problems.

You will own the technical execution of complex problems from initial concept through implementation, evaluation, product validation, and production readiness. You will use AI coding agents and agentic frameworks as part of your daily workflow and help the team do the same without sacrificing code quality, security, reliability, or architectural discipline. You will turn ambiguous needs into clear, testable specifications, measurable evaluation criteria, and executable engineering backlogs, then ensure validated concepts are production-ready or transferred to product engineering through clear documentation and structured handoffs.

What You'll Do

People Leadership

• Lead and mentor the team, fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, experimentation, and continuous improvement.

• Run effective 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development conversations that help each engineer grow, thrive, and understand what success looks like.

• Set clear expectations, provide timely feedback, recognize strong contributions, and address performance or team-health concerns directly and constructively.

• Hire, onboard, and develop engineers who can operate effectively in a fast-moving environment where tools, practices, and technical assumptions evolve quickly.

• Create an inclusive, psychologically safe team environment where engineers can challenge ideas, learn from failed experiments, and make decisions with appropriate speed and rigor.

• Balance the demands of people leadership and hands-on engineering, protecting focus while staying technically credible and accessible to the team.

Technical Leadership and Hands-On Engineering

•
Own R&D initiatives end to end. Take ideas through specification, technical design, implementation, testing, evaluation, product validation, documentation, production readiness, and a structured handoff to product engineering with a high degree of independence and accountability.

•
Build with AI in the loop. Use AI coding assistants, LLM APIs, coding agents, and agentic frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework or comparable orchestration technologies to accelerate coding, review, testing, and debugging, while exercising sound judgment about when not to rely on them. End-to-end SDLC experience

We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer for the Container Services team in San Francisco. About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets - the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Sales Director to lead the volume end of our Sales organization in EMEA. Tiers 2 and 3 make up the broad base of our client portfolio: a large number of banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms and advisors, with smaller account sizes than our Tier 1 and strategic clients. Retention, expansion and coverage at scale drive growth here.

You’ll lead a team of 6-8 Account Managers, each owning a book of Tier 2 and Tier 3 clients, and a small number of Account Executives winning new clients in the same tiers. You’ll own renewals and net retention for the segment, build a repeatable operating rhythm across a high volume of accounts, and grow a team within our newly tiered sales organization.

This is a hands-on leadership role reporting to the Head of Sales, EMEA & APAC. You’ll combine coaching with disciplined pipeline and forecast management, and you’ll be accountable for how your team performs against its number.

- Set coverage models and account prioritization so your team spends its time where the revenue and risk are.

- Run a clear operating cadence across the segment, including book and territory planning, account plans and a shared methodology.

- Recruit, onboard and develop the team, including training on demos, usage analysis and client reviews.

- Manage performance through structured reviews, goal setting and development plans.

- Partner with Customer Success, Sales Engineering, Enablement, Rev Ops, Marketing and Product to remove barriers to growth and bring client feedback into the roadmap.

- Work with the Head of Sales, EMEA & APAC and the US team to keep handovers, tiering and territories consistent globally.

- Keep accurate CRM records and forecasts, and use the data to coach and make decisions.

ABOUT YOU

This role will be a great fit if you:

- Have 5+ years of experience leading account management or commercial teams, ideally in capital markets, fintech or data and SaaS.

- Have a track record of managing high-volume books and delivering retention and growth across them.

- Are comfortable owning a team number and can show how you’ve consistently hit it.

- Have run a disciplined cadence of pipeline reviews, forecasting and account planning.

- Have a good knowledge of financial markets and the ability to build relationships across the buy side, sell side and advisory community.

- Are comfortable with CRM tools (Salesforce preferred) and use data to drive decisions.

description:
ABOUT US

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring an experienced Performance Marketer to own and scale paid search and emerging AI advertising channels at LangChain, starting with Google Ads, Bing (Microsoft Advertising), and ChatGPT.

You'll own the entire paid acquisition experience, from developing channel strategy and building campaigns to optimizing landing pages, improving conversion rates, and driving qualified pipeline.

This is a highly hands-on role. You'll be the person building campaigns, analyzing performance, testing creative, improving landing pages, and identifying new opportunities to scale.

We're looking for someone who combines deep paid search expertise with a willingness to experiment with emerging advertising platforms. You should be comfortable managing significant budgets, making data-driven investment decisions, and connecting advertising performance to downstream pipeline rather than just clicks, leads, or conversions.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

PAID ACQUISITION STRATEGY AND PIPELINE

- Develop channel-specific strategies based on audience intent, available targeting capabilities, and expected pipeline contribution.

- Develop testing roadmaps across audiences, messaging, bidding, conversion experiences, and new advertising formats.

END-TO-END CAMPAIGN EXECUTION

You'll own campaign execution across all three channels:

- Google Ads: Build, launch, and manage campaigns across branded, non-branded, competitor, and product search, including keyword research, match types, negative keywords, bidding, and budget optimization.

- Bing / Microsoft Advertising: Develop and manage campaigns tailored to Microsoft's search audience, identifying opportunities to extend reach and capture incremental high-intent demand.

- ChatGPT advertising: Develop and execute an early advertising strategy, testing available placements, audience approaches, messaging, and conversion experiences as the platform evolves.

- Creative and messaging: Write and test ad copy in partnership with Product Marketing, adapting messaging to each channel and its user intent.

- Experimentation: Run structured tests to improve acquisition efficiency, traffic quality, and pipeline conversion.

title: Director, Supply Chain
description:
About Terawatt Infrastructure
The once in a century transition to autonomous and electric vehicles is underway and will require a multi-trillion-dollar investment in energy and charging infrastructure, and the real estate to site it on. Terawatt is the leader in delivering large scale, turnkey charging solutions for companies rapidly deploying AV and EV fleets. Whether it’s an urban mobility hub, or a carefully located multi-fleet hub for semi-trucks, Terawatt brings the talent, capabilities, and capital to create reliable, cost-effective solutions for customers on the leading edge of the transition to the next generation of transport.
With a growing portfolio of sites across the US in urban hubs and along key logistics and transportation corridors. Terawatt is building the permanent transportation and logistics infrastructure of tomorrow through a robust combination of capital, real estate, development, and site operations solutions. The company develops, finances, owns, and operates charging solutions that take the cost and complexity out of electrifying fleets. 
Our Values
Six core values guide how we work: commitments we make to each other. Our pace is set by a simple conviction: imperfect action beats perfect inaction, so we move with purpose, adapt without ego, and measure ourselves by progress rather than activity. Ownership travels with autonomy. Your name is on the work, and the best answer wins the conversation, wherever it lives. That candor works because of what surrounds it: people who show up with intention and have each other's back, tough on ideas and generous with people. Our customers feel this as reliability earned daily, every interaction treated as a chance to build something lasting. And underneath it all is why the work matters. The climate doesn't wait, and the stakes are also human: behind every checklist and every inspection is a person going home safely. We call it "This work has a heartbeat” - it's what the other five rest on.

Compensation for this role is determined by several factors, including the cost of labor in specific geographic markets, and these ranges are intended to provide a helpful reference. The actual compensation offer will be based on the candidate’s location, skills, level of expertise and experience, and internal equity considerations. In addition to base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package and, where applicable, performance-based incentives.

We are building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), Cyber - NYC
description:
About the team

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team builds with customers to bring frontier AI into production. Our Cyber FDEs partner with the security and engineering teams that defend globally critical systems, from enterprise software to the core infrastructure it runs on. Cyber FDEs work closely with our Product, Research, and Go-to-Market teams to adapt our products and models to what customers need to defend their systems.

About the role

You’ll build systems that give defenders an advantage at a scale few engineering teams encounter. You might help an enterprise identify, test, and deploy patches across hundreds of thousands of code repositories, or help a security team analyze petabytes of logs for signs of malicious agents or coordinated attacks. Across these deployments, you’ll build tools that customer engineers can trust to support consequential security decisions.

You’ll work directly with customer security teams, from CISOs to frontline analysts. As AI changes how attackers operate, you’ll help these teams determine where their defenses need to evolve, prioritize what to build, and validate solutions with the engineers who will operate them. Alongside OpenAI’s account teams, you’ll translate security priorities into deployed systems that help defenders cover more ground.

You’ll also help shape what OpenAI builds next. When you identify a gap between what defenders need and what today’s models or products can do, you’ll partner with Research and Product to define, build, and test capabilities that address it.

This role is based in New York. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required.

In this role you will:

- Partner with customer security leaders and OpenAI’s Go-to-Market team to scope engagements, establish responsibilities, and define measurable success criteria.

- Lead technical design and implementation alongside customer engineers. Integrate agents into security workflows, establish access boundaries, and determine which actions require human review.

- Build evaluations grounded in the decisions defenders make. For a patching agent, test whether a fix blocks a known exploit while preserving expected application behavior. For a detection system, replay historical attacks alongside normal traffic to measure detection speed and false-positive rates.

- Guide production rollout with the engineers who will operate the system. Provide the observability and controls they need to understand system behavior, intervene when necessary, and expand adoption with confidence.

- Translate successful approaches across deployments into reusable tools and engineering practices that other defenders can adopt.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- 5+ years of software engineering experience, including building and shipping production software.

- Experience protecting production systems through work in security engineering, infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or product engineering.

- Experience building and evaluating AI agents for software engineering workflows.

- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and practices that maintain code quality, reliability, and security.

- Ability to navigate unfamiliar codebases and contribute maintainable, production-quality changes.

- Ability to communicate technical concepts and trade-offs to engineering teams and senior security stakeholders.

Additional experience

Cybersecurity spans many disciplines, and while we’re primarily looking for strong engineering generalists, we’d love to hear about deeper experience in any of the following areas:

- Security curiosity and experimentation: You read CVE write-ups because you want to understand how things break. You may have built an agent honeypot to test a hypothesis-or prove a point-and enjoy turning a security question into a hands-on experiment.

title: Director, Regulatory Affairs
description:
State regulators and departments of insurance, industry advocacy groups and more are actively deciding how aerial imagery and AI can be used in underwriting and rating. More than a dozen departments of insurance have issued bulletins on the subject, with imagery recency limits running from 180 days to two years, constraints on what evidence supports an adverse action, and new disclosure and appeal requirements for consumers. Legislation is moving in several more states, and a national model act is in draft. These rules determine how much of Nearmap 's value a carrier can realize, and in the most restrictive states they shape whether particular use cases are viable at all.
This role owns Nearmap 's answer. You will build and lead our insurance regulatory affairs function, setting our regulatory strategy, engaging with regulators and legislators to help inform and understand the latest changes, and advising insurance customers on best practices for using Nearmap AI products in admitted markets. You will track every bulletin and bill that touches imagery and AI, and you will publish the positions our customers and our field can rely on.
The framework for imagery and AI for the insurance industry is still being written, and you will put Nearmap in the room, arguing standards that reflect what current imagery and AI can support.
You will be starting from a solid foundation. Nearmap data is approved in more than fifty rate filings, and we maintain a working database of state bulletins and legislation. What we do not have is a single owner. This is a builder role with immediate impact: you will step into active filing engagements from week one, and you will build the function behind them, which includes the state playbooks and the positions Nearmap stands behind.
You will report into Insurance Product, which puts you close to where new attributes and scores are designed, and you will work daily with data science, actuarial, Legal, and our customer-facing teams.
You'll be the regulatory face of Nearmap :

• Act as the named Nearmap contact across the filing lifecycle, from pre-filing consultation through objection response and post-approval maintenance.

• Own Nearmap regulatory strategy, which includes where we will register, where and what we will file, and how. You’ll partner with insurance carriers to jointly design regulatory approaches that suit their needs.

• Lead objection response strategy, drawing analytical inputs from our actuarial and data science teams.

• Own our advisory organization relationship and the subscriber mechanics that sit between us and our carrier customers, and establish where those requirements are regulatory and where they are commercial.

• Develop a recommendation on advisory organization registration beyond our existing Arizona registration and own this strategy on an ongoing basis as the regulatory landscape continues to evolve.

• Partner with Legal on the privilege, contractual, and compliance questions that arise from filings and regulator engagement.

You'll own the filing program:

• Own Nearmap rate filing approach end-to-end to support carrier filing programs: scoping, materials, submission coordination, tracking, objection response, and close.

• Coordinate on and collaborate with cross functional teams to support a rate filing materials library, including model memos, validation summaries, and methodology documentation, for every Nearmap attribute and score used in rating.

• Maintain state-by-state command of filing requirements, permissible confidentiality treatment, and filer eligibility.

• Manage version control and re-filing triggered by model updates, new attributes, validation findings, or regulator feedback.

• Monitor regulatory filings across all states and maintain up-to-date database of rating plans that use aerially derived data.

You'll help shape the rules, not just follow them:

• Track NAIC, NAMIC, and NCOIL activity on insurance AI and imagery, including the NAIC AI Syst

title: Koordinátor vozového parku
description:
O SPOLEČNOSTI

Rohlík je evropským lídrem v online prodeji potravin, založeným v roce 2014 v České republice. Našim službám dnes důvěřují zákazníci v České republice, Maďarsku, Rakousku, Německu, Itálii a Rumunsku. Věnujeme pozornost každému detailu, abychom zákazníkům přinesli skvělý zážitek, a zároveň pomáháme farmářům růst tím, že nabízíme jedinečné a exkluzivní značky, které jinde v obchodech nenajdete. V Praze, Brně a Ostravě už obsluhujeme přes 200 000 zákazníků a stovky aut denně rozvážejí tisíce objednávek. Spojuje nás stejná vášeň, měnit nákupní zvyklosti napříč střední Evropou.

 

O ODDĚLENÍ

Náš Fleet tým se stará o to, aby vozidla stojící za naším last mile doručováním fungovala spolehlivě, bezpečně a efektivně. Protože Rohlík vlastní celý svůj vozový park místo toho, aby ho leasoval, tým má na starosti kompletní životní cyklus vozidel vlastními silami, od servisu a oprav až po pojištění a každodenní dostupnost aut.

Vaše práce bude mít přímý dopad na plynulost provozu, dostupnost aut i rychlost odbavení tisíců objednávek každý den.

 

CO OD VÁS OČEKÁVÁME

- Správa evidence vozového parku na pobočce, včetně najetých kilometrů, historie servisů, poruch a nehod

- Udržování všech dat o vozidlech přesných a aktuálních

- Řešení pojistných událostí a veškeré související dokumentace

- Sledování faktur a dokladů od poskytovatelů služeb

- Monitorování dostupnosti a kapacity vozidel pro logistické manažery

- Plánování servisních zásahů a preventivní údržby

- Podpora řidičů v jejich každodenních provozních potřebách

- Vyšetřování poškození vozidel, identifikace odpovědných osob a zpracování souvisejících nákladů

- Kontrola a schvalování servisních faktur a operací

- Sledování a správa náhradních dílů, spotřebního materiálu a netechnického vybavení, jako jsou polyboxy a štítky

- Vedení týmu techniků, včetně plánování směn a docházky

- Komunikace s poskytovateli servisních služeb za účelem optimalizace nákladů na opravy

- Správa faktur a objednávek v interních systémech

- Péče o sdílená vozidla v areálu

- Vedení a koordinace týmu pro vyzvedávání zásilek, včetně náboru a vedení jeho členů

 

CO U VÁS HLEDÁME

- Technické nebo automobilové vzdělání, případně praktická zkušenost se správou vozového parku nebo dílny

- Minimálně dva roky zkušeností s řízením vozového parku nebo vedením servisní dílny

- Logické myšlení a schopnost rychle a kreativně rozhodovat pod tlakem

- Schopnost zvládat krizové situace klidně a efektivně

- Schopnost pracovat s velkým množstvím provozních dat se zaměřením na výsledky

- Spravedlivý a konzistentní přístup při řešení konfliktů mezi kolegy nebo dalšími stranami

- Silné komunikační schopnosti napříč odděleními

- Ochota rychle se přizpůsobovat vyvíjejícím se procesům a prioritám

 

CO VÁM NABÍZÍME

- Férovou odměnu - Dostaneš atraktivní fixní mzdu - bez bonusových her a politiky. Dobrá práce si zaslouží jasné a férové uznání.

- Dobré jídlo každý den - Každý den si můžeš dát oběd zdarma a v kanceláři tě čeká čerstvé ovoce a zelenina. Protože dobré jídlo dělá dobrou práci.

- Volno navíc - Víme, že odpočinek je důležitý. Kromě zákonné dovolené proto můžeš po domluvě čerpat i placené volno navíc, vždy s ohledem na plán směn a provozní potřeby.

- Xtra členství - Získáš členství Xtra zdarma a 10% cashback na všechny nákupy na Rohlik.cz http://Rohlik.cz.

- Sport a wellbeing - Zůstaneš v pohybu díky firemním sportovním výzvám nebo dotované Multisport kartě.

- Bezpečné zázemí pro práci - Pracuješ v moderním skladu, kde dostaneš potřebné vybavení a podporu, abys svou práci mohl/a dělat dobře a bezpečně.

- Tým, který táhne za jeden provaz - Ve skladu je důležitá spolupráce. Budeš součástí týmu, kde si lidé pomáhají, drží tempo a společně zvládají každodenní provoz.

- Práce, která má smysl - Díky tvojí práci se čerstvé potraviny dostanou včas k tisícům zákazníků. Každá správně připravená objednávka má reálný dopad.

title: Legal Operations Associate
description:
Role Description
Dropbox is seeking a highly organized and strategic Legal Operations Associate to join our Legal team. This individual will play a critical role in supporting the operational infrastructure that underpins our legal function. You will manage and optimize multiple legal systems, partner cross-functionally with internal teams, and serve as a key driver of efficiency and innovation across the legal organization.
The ideal candidate brings deep experience in legal operations, is technically proficient in legal platforms like JSM, Confluence, Ironclad and legal AI tooling, like Spellbook, and thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced tech environment. This role is highly visible and provides a unique opportunity to shape how Dropbox ’s Legal team operates today and scales for tomorrow.
Responsibilities

• Design and lead legal team workflows, policies, and processes to improve efficiency.

• Implement and manage legal technology tools(e.g., CLM, eBilling, matter management).

• Drive legal department KPIs, reporting, and dashboards to measure performance and value.

• Support the rollout of Legal’s front door in Jira Service Management and the onboarding of additional Legal teams, including testing changes, documenting configurations, and training users.

• Oversee outside counsel and legal vendor engagements, onboarding, and billing.

• Manage the legal team’s tech stack and collaborate with IT as needed.

• Partner with IT, Finance, Procurement, Compliance, and other key teams on operational initiatives.

• Ensure smooth communication between Legal and business stakeholders.

• Partner with Legal teams to translate process needs into practical configurations and refine workflows based on user feedback and request trends.

• Coordinate with CIT and the Atlassian team for platform guidance, troubleshooting, integrations, and changes requiring broader technical support.

• Maintain centralized repositories for contracts, templates, policies, and legal knowledge.

• Help maintain Legal’s Confluence knowledge base, working with subject-matter owners to organize approved guidance and support self-service and AI-assisted responses.

• Lead or support legal projects from planning to execution, including process improvement and change adoption.

• Identify opportunities for automation and implement solutions to reduce manual workload.

Requirements

• 3+ years of experience in legal operations, strong track record for project management, or operations roles within a legal department or law firm.

• Tech industry experience and familiarity with commercial transactions strongly preferred.

• Background experience with legal systems and technologies such as JSM, Confluence, Ironclad, Spellbook, and Brightflag knowledge are a plus, but not required.

• Strong track record for project management and process optimization.

• Excellent communication, collaboration, interpersonal and organizational skills.

• Eagerness to learn new things and ability to navigate complicated and nuanced issues.

• Familiarity with contracting and procurement processes, as well as with negotiating, drafting and advising clients on commercial contracts is a plus but not required.

• Familiarity with knowledge management, content organization and access controls.

• Ability to translate business requirements into system configurations, troubleshoot issues and document changes.

• BA/BS from a top university and excellent academic credentials.

• Familiarity with team-managed JSM projects and working within shared platform standards.
